title: Shor In The City
desc: A film set in Mumbai, India. The movie revolves around the lives of three men who get caught up in the chaos of the city. The first story follows two small-time crooks who attempt to pull off a heist. The second story focuses on a struggling cricketer who gets caught up in a web of corruption. The third story is about a young couple trying to find their way in the chaotic city. As their lives intersect, they must navigate through the noisy and bustling streets of Mumbai to find their own paths.

title: Salaam-E-Ishq
desc: Salaam-e-ishq is a story that weaves six love stories together from different walks of life, in the bustling city of Mumbai. Ignorant about each other's existence, but end up being brought together by destiny, fate and LOVE. Set in the themes of betrayal, love and forgiveness , the film navigates the ups and downs and complexities of the modern relationships.

title: Khuda Kasam The Challenge
desc: CBI officer Neetu Singh is framed for the assassination of a chief minister. She attempts to solve this murder mystery with the help of a man who is sentenced to prison for a crime he never committed.
